report:
Final settings: batch_size 4, workers 14, prefetch 0. Final throughput: 700.0 req/s at p99 199.0 ms, within the 200 ms hard limit.

Start: batch_size 8, workers 1, prefetch 0 gave 100.0 req/s at p99 197.2 ms.

Method: I searched every whole-number setting (batch_size 1 to 9, workers 1 to 29, prefetch 0 to 39) with the bench model and kept only settings with p99 at or below 200 ms. The hard limit was a filter, never traded against throughput.

Next best settings, all within the limit:
- batch_size 5, workers 11, prefetch 0: 687.5 req/s, p99 200.0 ms (exactly at the limit, no margin)
- batch_size 4, workers 13, prefetch 1: 676.0 req/s, p99 197.3 ms

Note: the chosen setting leaves 1.0 ms of p99 margin. The bench is a deterministic model; real p99 may vary, so a live check is advised before rollout.
